card.name: Words just before organization or company
card.fires_on: Small linking words or modifiers (the, of, domain, social) right before a likely noun like organization, company or agency. It fires where the next word is expected to name an organizing body or structure.

modes.label: Before 'organization'
modes.description: Linking word or modifier where 'organization' comes next, as structure or arrangement.
modes.example: The amino acid sequence and<< domain>> organization of the C. albicans RNA

modes.label: Before 'company'
modes.description: Word like 'the' after a verb of control, where 'company' is expected.
modes.example: Common stockholders have the right to control<< the>> company through their voting rights, unless such

modes.label: Other group nouns
modes.description: Word before a body, system or agency in general prose.
modes.example: The folks at<< communications>> agency Dentsu London and design consultancy

card.writes: It suppresses organization and company words, so it lowers the chance that the next word is one of these.
card.plain: It marks spots where a word like organization or company would be expected next, and holds that word back.
